text:
maya chen: heads up — found ~2.8k prompts that dedupe-hash into the same bucket after the UTF-8 normalize change, looks like a collision cluster
liam park: :eyes: can you paste an example?
maya chen: quick repro — two visually-identical variants ended up identical after we normalize+truncate the digest
```python
>>> import hashlib
>>> a = 'mañana'
>>> b = 'man\u0303ana'
>>> hashlib.sha1(a.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
'8b1a9953c4611296a827abf8c47804d7'
>>> hashlib.sha1(b.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
'8b1a9953c4611296a827abf8c47804d7'
# local repro using current pipeline NFKC + 64-bit truncate returns same value
```
jorge rodriguez: that's rough. is this due to the 64-bit truncate we added for speed, or the NFKC change?
maya chen: both — NFKC merged codepoints, then we truncated digest to 64 bits for index size. collision surface is tiny but hits multilingual cohorts.
anya-labelops-bot: Noted. Labels impacted: 175 golden items overlapped with live batches (reported in labeling dashboard).
samira khan: what's the proposed mitigation? revert truncate or do resample?
maya chen: proposed plan:
- expand dedupe digest to 128 bits for the next pass (minimal perf hit)
- run targeted resample for affected cohorts (approx 1.2k neighbor items)
- mark the 175 golden items for relabel + QA audit
Need labeling capacity estimate before we push batch.
labeler-ek1: I can take the relabel batch. ETA ~2 days once it's in the queue (we'll need clear instructions).
liam park: also recommend a tiny quant-regression smoke: run v1.9-quant8 vs v1.9-fp16 on the affected items — previous quant change touched tokenization path, want to be safe.
maya chen: agreed. I'll wire up the eval. Created sheet and scripts: https://redwood-internal/sheets/d/abc123 (internal)
```bash
# quick collision finder (pseudo)
python detect_collisions.py --input cohort_hashes.json --out collisions.json
```
jorge rodriguez: can we also stash the original pre-normalize strings so QA can inspect diffs?
maya chen: yes, ingestion logs preserve raw_text field; we'll include raw_text in the relabel export.
liam park: I'll set up an eval job on small TF instance, comparing accept-rate + token-delta + simple BLEU between quant and fp16. ETA ~3 hours once samples available. Will post script/link.
maya chen: assigning tasks: @liam to eval + script, @samira to monitor labeling capacity and QA, @labeler-ek1 to do relabel. I will kick off the rehash + resample tonight in low-traffic window.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: dedupe-worker rehash job queued for 2026-03-21 01:30 UTC.
samira khan: ack — will watch logs and post any pipeline errors here.
maya chen: update: rehash ran, found 183 true collisions after expanding to 128-bit, resample created relabel batch of 1,342 items and flagged 183 golden candidates. labeler-ek1 accepted the batch. Running eval now, will report deltas in ~48h.
